REACH YOUR PEAK MENTAL PERFORMANCE AND RECLAIM YOUR ATTENTION.

Do you find it impossible to focus in a world designed to distract you?

Silly question, I know.

That is why, as a solo developer, I created this app for personal use, which I have now decided to share.

Mind Focus helps you perform at your best in your work, studies, or tasks, reclaiming the attention that has been stolen from us to devote it to our goals and stop being a puppet of the algorithms.

Based on neuroscience and performance psychology, Mind Focus allows:

1. IMMEDIATE MENTAL PERFORMANCE. Combining the most powerful tools science endorses for deep work and total concentration: Pomodoro Techniques and Isochronic Tones.

2. ATTENTIONAL TRAINING. With proven practices to improve attention and recover an overstimulated mind.

3. REST. With the most effective relaxation and stress reduction techniques.

1. IMMEDIATE PERFORMANCE: POMODORO AND ISOCHRONIC TONES

This combination maximizes productivity and total attention:

• ADVANCED POMODORO AND FLOWMODORO: Follow natural cycles of deep work and restorative breaks with Pomodoros (25 minutes of work and 5 minutes of rest) or "Flowmodoros", where you define the duration of the intervals, adapting them to your natural rhythms.

And also, a FREE MODE, without set intervals.

This is combined with:

• ISOCHRONIC TONES WITH ADVANCED AND ADAPTIVE GENERATION: Mind Focus uses rhythmic sound pulses that naturally synchronize brain waves with states of high concentration.

They have been chosen over binaural beats because studies indicate greater effectiveness and you have 2 main modes.

• FOCUS (Beta Waves): Ideal for everyday tasks and sustained daily work.

• ULTRAFOCUS (Gamma Waves): For complex challenges that require maximum processing capacity and problem-solving.

THE GREAT DIFFERENCE FROM OTHER APPS AND TONES

Mind Focus is the first app to combine them with Pomodoros and generate them...

• Intelligently. It is NOT an mp3 on a loop, they are created on the fly differently depending on various factors.

• Their generation follows a ramp system so the brain adapts in a smooth and natural way.

• They also understand the time of day and, following the natural human circadian rhythm, generate the most suitable tones.

quotes.text:
I don't really know how to do this. I'm a Spanish solo dev and solo writer, and a long time ago I created an Android app for personal use, called Mind Focus, that has helped me work more focused and take back my attention.

And now I've gotten up the nerve to share it because I think it can be useful to others.

To that end, I've combined two things that have personally worked for me and are also backed by data:

The Pomodoro technique (and time-boxing in general as a task management approach).
Isochronic tones (along with other sounds like pink or brown noise). Personally, they have worked better for me than other options like binaural beats, and emerging science also seems to corroborate greater effectiveness (yes, I like to dig up obscure studies, here is some science behind the app https://www.ataraxiaapps.com/en/posts/science-behind-mindfocus/).
The novelty beyond the combination of both things is that the tones used aren't MP3s on a loop, but generated on the fly, with an adaptive ramp system to naturally accustom the brain to the appropriate focus frequency.

Likewise, the tone generation algorithm takes into account the time of day (and the natural ultradian rhythms in people) to generate the optimal frequency.

Besides that, I've also gathered what has worked best for me to try to tame my eternal anxiety (for example, breathing techniques like the physiological sigh) or recover an attention ravaged by the algorithm.
